title: docs: cite landing commits where pending changesets and source comments name 32 objectui issues that answer 404 (objectui#10803, batch 3)
body:
Part of #10803
Clause-②: no

Dispatched implementation of the `domain:ui` seat #2 claim (comment `5860873556`) on objectui#10803, batch 3, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`; patch round 1 applies the seat ruling `5861129870` on the round's two open questions, and patch round 2 applies contract review `5861306588` (two wording fixes and one optional nit) and the ruling's amendment `5861311219`. Citations only: no sentence's claim moves, and every edited pending changeset's frontmatter is byte-identical. The runtime text that moves loses its dead pointer and nothing else: four ADR-0049 tombstone guidance strings and two zod `.describe()` strings in `@object-ui/types`, and the Studio CEL authoring advisory in `@object-ui/app-shell`. The six tests that pin the tombstone text, the two changesets and two `content/docs` pages that quote it follow the changed string, and nothing else in them moves.

## Why `Part of`, not a closing line

The card stays open for the other 83 numbers of the family remainder (seat amendment `5860244997`, Q2 = A).

## The seat ruling `5861129870` and its amendment `5861311219`, as applied

- **Q1, the tombstone guidance class: a seat variant of option A, as amended.** Each of the four runtime tombstone strings keeps the house `RETIRED (REF) —` shape with `ADR-0049` as the reference, in place of the dead card. The ruling first conditioned `ADR-0049` on the key's TypeScript twin comment naming it: the twins of `TreeViewSchema.data` and `ChartDataSeriesSchema.data` (`data-display.ts`) and of `TextSchema.value` (`layout.ts`) each read "RETIRED (SHA, ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove)", while the twin of `DashboardConfigSchema.aria` is a deletion note on `DashboardConfig` in `designer.ts` that names no ADR, so round 1 shipped `RETIRED —` there. The amendment `5861311219` corrects that proxy: the `aria` retirement is itself ADR-0049 (the comment above `DashboardConfigSchema` in `complex.zod.ts`, its landing commit `e7957ab87`, and the pending `dashboard-config-aria-retired-5852.md` all say so), so `aria`'s error and describe strings also open `RETIRED (ADR-0049) —`. All four now read alike. Everything after the dash is unchanged. No sha enters runtime text.
- **Q2, the CEL advisory: A.** The pointer drop in `rowCanonAdvisory` stands, as shipped in round 1.
- **Folded (triage item 3):** the bare PR numbers #5505 and #5758, see **Mapping** and **Special cases** 4 and 2.
- **Review `5861306588`, taken in full:** the #5738 stand-down 3 sites name the card by role behind the sha (**Special cases** 2); the runtime-strings changeset's second sentence no longer says every pointer is dropped; and, the optional nit, the sweep changeset names the role-named case.
- **`main`:** `main` (`fab627ff9`) was merged in during round 1 by a merge commit (`2cb9b253f`), no rebase and no force-push. The branch is 0 commits behind it, so round 2 merged nothing. Every reading below is on the head `dd37e35d2`.

## Premise, re-measured

- REST `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/N` for each of the 32: all 32 answer 404, and a second read of each answers 404 again (32 of 32). `GET .../pulls/N` answers 404 for all 32 too. Lit controls: objectui#10533 and objectui#7714 answer 200. No number was dropped from the batch.
- The two folded bare PR numbers, #5505 and #5758, answer 404 on both `issues/N` and `pulls/N`.
- The same 32 in objectstack all answer 200. Their subjects are unrelated to the objectui sentences (for example objectstack#5425 is the U+0000 finding about `useDatasetFields.ts`, objectstack#5418 the language-menu card). The only objectstack-qualified sites these numbers have in the in-scope classes already spell `objectstack#` (`objectstack#5425` in `useDatasetFields.ts`, `objectstack#5418` twice in `i18n`'s `provider.tsx`, and `objectstack#5505` twice in `components`): live sister citations, untouched. Every other site names an objectui card, confirmed by its landing commit below, so no site is re-qualified.
- Every edited changeset is pending: it is present in `.changeset/` on `main`.
- Branch point: `a60539b07`. Not a shallow checkout.

## Census (the enumeration pin for this batch)

The instrument PR objectui#10854 printed, with this batch's 32 numbers and the two folded ones substituted (REF = a commit):

```
git grep -nE '(objectui#|#|issues/)(3499|3559|4784|5197|5221|5286|5309|5399|5401|5413|5414|5416|5417|5418|5425|5505|5518|5533|5709|5738|5741|5758|5852|5859|6296|6464|6661|6740|6757|6854|6859|6864|6896|6951)([^0-9]|$)' REF -- '.changeset/*.md' 'packages/*/src/**' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!**/*.test.*' ':!**/*.spec.*' ':!**/test/**' ':!**/tests/**' | grep -v 'objectstack#' | wc -l
```

- REF = `a60539b07` (branch point): **217** lines (216 for the 32 alone: 56 changeset lines in 47 files and 160 src-nontest lines in 77 files; the folded #5758 adds one line, and #5505 sits on two lines #5401 already counts). REF = `fab627ff9` (current `main`): 217.
- REF = `dd37e35d2` (this head, `main` merged in): **0**.
- This head merged with a fresh `main` (`fab627ff9`, `git merge-tree --write-tree`, clean): **0**.
- The instrument's blind spot, measured: its `grep -v 'objectstack#'` drops a whole line that ALSO names an objectstack number. One in-scope line was hidden that way, `ActionRunner`'s `onSuccess` block ("objectui#5221, the console half of objectstack#9566/#9474"); it is re-pointed here too. Without the filter the instrument reads 5 at this head, all live `objectstack#` lines (the three above and `objectstack#5505` twice).
- Lit control, the same printed instrument over live objectui#7714 at this head: 17 lines. Hex-colour false positives (a number followed by a hex letter) at the branch point: 0.
- Out of scope, as it stands (the card's instrument with the 34 numbers, unfiltered, whole tree at this head): 283 test lines in 121 files, 4 scripts lines in 2 files, 0 `.github`, 0 governed, and 24 other lines in 20 files (published `CHANGELOG.md` history, `content/docs`, two package READMEs, and `apps/console`; see **Acceptance notes** 3). The test count includes the `@ts-expect-error` comments named in **Acceptance notes** 5.

## Citation form

- The 9-character backticked sha of the commit on `main` that landed the change the sentence rests on, as in PRs objectui#10707 / #10766 / #10797 / #10854. All 32 distinct shas below (the two folded numbers reuse two of them) are ancestors of `main` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0 each; control leg: the head of PR objectui#10714 answers exit 1, and a known ancestor `5f789538d` answers exit 0 in the same checkout), and `git rev-parse --short=9` returns the same 9 characters for each.
- A changeset's pointer to its OWN card is dropped, not replaced: `@changesets/changelog-git` prefixes each released entry with the hash of the commit that added the file, which is that landing. Where dropping the pointer left a dangling word, the clause was minimally repaired (listed in **Special cases**).
- Where the sentence cites a RULING and no single commit is the ruling, the ruling is cited by its date: "the 2026-08-23 ruling" (the dashboard widget-options ruling, option B, recorded in `8d58f46b4`'s message), "the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-31" (the chart `categories` ruling, recorded in `b0d308da9`'s).
- Runtime text carries no sha. Inside a zod `.describe()` string and in the author-facing CEL advisory the dead pointer is dropped (amendment `5860244997`, Q1 = A; ruling `5861129870`, Q2 = A). A tombstone guidance string keeps its `RETIRED (REF) —` shape with `ADR-0049` as the reference (ruling `5861129870`, Q1, as amended by `5861311219`).
- Where nothing answers, the pointer is dropped and the sentence names the card by role (#5518 only).

## Special cases (the judgement calls)

1. **#5518, `StudioDesignSurface`'s nav inspector.** "is objectui#5518, deliberately left out of #4881's scope" becomes "is a follow-up card's question, deliberately left out of #4881's scope". Nothing lands it (the fallback read is still there) and no successor is recorded in history, so the card is named by role.
2. **#5738 "stand-down 3", and #5758.** The finding (RLS and flow conditions are not row surfaces) was recorded on the dead Phase-0 corpus-sweep card, not in a commit. `702c48a62` is that sweep's landing and the squash of PR #5758, but it is a one-line `plugin-form/README.md` edit that says nothing about a stand-down, so it cannot carry the finding (review `5861306588`). The card is therefore named by role, with the sha only to locate it: "(objectui#5738 stand-down 3)" becomes "(stand-down 3 on the corpus-sweep card behind `702c48a62`)" in the `conditionScope.ts` file docblock and in `7727-conditional-formatting-record-scope.md`, and the `sharing_rule` doc of `CONDITION_SCOPE_BY_METADATA_TYPE` reads "a stand-down 3 surface of the corpus-sweep card behind `702c48a62`". `rowPredicateCanon.ts` is different: "(the objectui#5738 corpus sweep, PR #5758's recipe)" becomes "(the `702c48a62` corpus sweep's recipe)", and that commit's message does carry the recipe (the `detectNonCanonicalRowSpelling` oracle); the review found it correct.
3. **#5221, `consoleServerAction.ts`.** "precedence — objectui#5221 escalates it" becomes "precedence — the card behind `053fdc8f9` escalates it": the escalation lived on the card, and no later ruling on that precedence is in history.
4. **#5401 and #5505.** In `visibilityDiagnostic.ts`, "(objectui#5401 → #5454)" becomes "(objectui#5454)": the dead predecessor goes, the live successor the sentence already named stays. In `data-table.tsx` and `5926-empty-action-visible-when.md`, "objectui#5401 / #5505 closed for `record:alert`" becomes "`c86185eb5` closed for `record:alert`": `c86185eb5` is the squash of PR #5505, so the card / PR pair is one landing.
5. **"that card" after a re-point.** Where the next words leaned on the dead card, they were repaired minimally: "on the flag that card was not about" becomes "that change was not about" (`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`, `gate-listlocalinstalls-marketplace-5620.md`); "The card's complaint was" becomes "The complaint it answered was" (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`); "is that card's to declare, not this one's to guess" becomes ", the caller's to declare, not this list's to guess" (`ConditionBuilder.tsx`'s `REFERENCE_ROOTS`); "belongs to objectui#6296" becomes ", which `88b15fddc` added" (`6293-conditionbuilder-reference-value.md`); "the unstaffed state objectui#5414 asks to surface" becomes "the unstaffed state `77f846a8b` surfaces"; "is not what objectui#5414 reports" becomes "is not what `77f846a8b` fixes".
6. **Rulings by date.** "(objectui#5709 ruling)" becomes "(maintainer ruling 2026-08-23)" in the #5709 changeset (own card) and "(the 2026-08-23 ruling; ...)" in `validate.ts`; "whose objectui#5709 ruling states the constraint" becomes "whose 2026-08-23 ruling states" in `kanban-quick-add.ts`; "ruled LIVE by objectui#6896 (maintainer ruling 2026-08-31, prose follows machine)" becomes "ruled LIVE by the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-31 (prose follows machine)" in `ChartRenderer.tsx`, and `8650-chart-foreign-dialect-retired.md`'s "ruled live by objectui#6896" becomes "ruled live by the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-31".
7. **"Phase 2" wording.** "the warning objectui#5741 deleted" becomes "the warning Phase 2 (`83fe6e741`) deleted" in `celAuthoring.ts`, so the next sentence's "That ruling" keeps its antecedent; "objectui#5741 Phase 2 retired" becomes "Phase 2 (`83fe6e741`) retired" in `ConditionBuilder.tsx` and `8167-conditionbuilder-mount-scope.md`; `layout.ts`'s "objectui#6951 (maintainer ruling A1, 2026-09-04) decided it" becomes "maintainer ruling A1 (2026-09-04, `5ad86ddee`) decided it".
8. **Own-card pointers that needed a word.** `dashboard-table-header-one-spelling-5425.md`: "the defect class objectui#5425 rules out" becomes "the defect class this change rules out". `6757-global-search-notifications-renderers.md` and the two #6951 changesets: the parenthesis opened on its own card, so the line break moved with it ("page blocks.", "is RETIRED" then "(maintainer ruling ...)"). `6854-layout-renderer-retired-onclick.md`: "(objectui#6854, maintainer ruling ...)" becomes "(the maintainer ruling ...)".

10. **What follows the tombstone strings, and nothing else in it.** The literal anchors on the old text in the six pinning tests: `dashboard-config.test.ts` (`/RETIRED \(objectui#5852\)/` becomes `/^RETIRED \(ADR-0049\) — /`; the "delete the key" remedy anchor stays), `tree-view-data-retired-6951.test.ts` and `text-value-retired-6951.test.ts` (the full `GUIDANCE` literal's opening and the `describeOf` anchor; `PRESCRIPTIVE` stays), `chart-inline-data-retired.test.ts` (three anchors; the `xAxisKey` and chart-level `data` remedy anchors stay), `chart-data-model-7113.test.ts` and `chart-series-keys-7546.test.ts` (one anchor each). The two changeset quotes (`6951-text-value-retired.md`, `6951-tree-view-data-retired.md`, frontmatter byte-identical) and the two `content/docs` quotes (`text.mdx`, `tree-view.mdx`) open `RETIRED (ADR-0049) —`. Per the ruling these follow the changed string; they do not widen the card's classes. No test, doc or changeset quotes either `aria` string (whole-tree search after the amendment: the source line is the only hit).

## Held

**By the serial rule: nothing.** The open-PR list was read at the start (11 open) and re-read for each round; at round 2 there are 9 open besides this one and the release PR: objectui#10873, #10871, #10870, #10852, #10821, #10780, #10777, #10714 and #10278. In round 1, two of them touched files this PR edits: objectui#10821 (`types/src/objectql.ts`, `types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`) and objectui#10714 (`types/src/data-display.ts`, `types/src/layout.ts`, `types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`, `types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`). Each one's hunks (3 lines of context) were mapped onto the head through a line alignment of the PR's merge-base file: **none of the 22 lines this PR changes in those files lies inside, or beside, any hunk.** objectui#10871 (new since) touches `celAuthoring.ts` and `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` in disjoint hunks (review `5861306588`), and no open PR touches a file round 2 edits. Trial merges of each open PR head with this head (`git merge-tree --write-tree`): clean for #10873, #10871, #10870, #10852, #10780, #10777 and #10714; #10821 (`24bcb0035`) and #10278 (`eab4c8e52`) conflict, but each conflicts identically against `main` alone, so the conflicts are not this PR's. PR #5400 (Version Packages) regenerates and is not a hold.

## Changesets

- `.changeset/10803-dead-citation-sweep-third-batch.md`, EMPTY frontmatter: the comment-only edits in 12 released packages; no published behaviour changes through them. Its list of citation forms now ends "or a live successor, and where nothing answers they name the card by role" (the review's optional nit), and it points at the second file for the runtime text.
- `.changeset/10803-third-batch-runtime-strings.md`, `'@object-ui/types': patch` and `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. Its second sentence now reads "so no dead pointer becomes a commit: tombstones cite `ADR-0049` in its place, and every other pointer is simply dropped" (review `5861306588` fix 2, in the amendment's all-four wording). It names the four tombstones, all now opening `RETIRED (ADR-0049) —` (`TreeViewSchema.data`, `TextSchema.value`, `ChartDataSeriesSchema.data`, and `DashboardConfigSchema.aria`'s error and describe text), with no process clause about a TypeScript twin; then the two describe strings and the advisory. Nothing after a tombstone's dash moves, and no key, path, issue code, accept set, refusal or severity moves.

## Proof of prose-only (C4), against `main` `fab627ff9`

- **Source.** Each of the 77 touched non-test `.ts` / `.tsx` files was parsed at `fab627ff9` (the `main` merged in, so the diff is exactly this PR's) and at this head with TypeScript 6.0.3's `createSourceFile` and re-printed by `createPrinter({ removeComments: true })`: 73 of 77 prints are identical, and the other 4 (`celAuthoring.ts`, `complex.zod.ts`, `data-display.zod.ts`, `layout.zod.ts`) are equal after exactly the 9 listed string substitutions are applied to the `main` print (each matched once): the 4 tombstone strings in 5 literals, the 3 describe-string deletions and the advisory's. 0 parse diagnostics. Lit controls on the same instrument: dropping "(ADR-0049)" from the `TextSchema.value` string moves the print; re-spacing a comment does not.
